title: Passive voice
point: Use be + past participle when what happens to something matters more than who did it.

sentences.ja: このお店は1950年に創業しました。
sentences.note: Businesses "were founded" or "were opened"; the passive is the natural choice.

sentences.ja: 昨日、自転車を盗まれました。
sentences.note: Avoid "I was stolen my bike"; the thing stolen becomes the subject.

sentences.ja: この部屋は毎朝掃除されています。
sentences.text: This room is cleaned every morning.

sentences.ja: 授業は台風のため休講になりました。
sentences.text: Class was canceled because of the typhoon.

sentences.ja: 彼はパーティーに招待されなかった。
sentences.text: He wasn't invited to the party.

sentences.ja: この曲は世界中で愛されています。
sentences.text: This song is loved all over the world.

sentences.ja: 会議は来週に延期されました。
sentences.text: The meeting has been postponed until next week.

sentences.ja: その論文はまだ出版されていません。
sentences.text: The paper hasn't been published yet.

sentences.ja: この写真は祖父が撮ったものです。
sentences.text: This photo was taken by my grandfather.
sentences.note: Keep "by" only when the person really matters, as here.

sentences.ja: ここでは英語とスペイン語が話されています。
sentences.text: English and Spanish are spoken here.
